title: Conductive material dispersed solution and secondary battery prepared by using the same
abstract: In the present invention, a conductive material including a bundle-type carbon nanotube; a dispersing agent comprising a hydrogenated nitrile-based rubber; and a dispersion medium, and provides a conductive material dispersion solution having a complex modulus of elasticity (|G*| @1Hz) of 20 Pa to 500 Pa when the frequency is 1 Hz when measured with a rheometer, and a secondary battery manufactured using the same. The dispersion of the conductive material exhibits excellent dispersibility and powder resistance characteristics by having a controlled complex modulus, and as a result, it is possible to significantly improve the output characteristics of the battery.
